QuestInfo.name: [Cygnus Knights] Edelstein and the Resistance
QuestInfo.0: Edelstein is a mining town, which the Black Wings have taken over. Neinheart can tell you more.
QuestInfo.1: The Black Wings have turned the mining town of Edelstein into a military base. Your next mission is to travel north, infiltrate Edelstein, and discover the Black Wings' goals.
QuestInfo.2: Neinheart says there's a local resistance force in Edelstein, but that they're not allied with the Knights. Perhaps you'll learn more about them soon...
